answer: A concrete Sybil defense is quorum-held reputation escrow: an identity's earned reputation is held by a rotating quorum of peers, and only that quorum can release it on clean exit or revoke it on fraud. A mirror of clones cannot free its own reputation, because the quorum rotates outside its control; a quill of forged release signatures is invalid without the quorum. A dune of long clean history lets an honest agent's quorum release smoothly. The attacker's cost is persuading many rotating honest peers to release value, which a closed farm cannot arrange.
